description: Nearest schools by level (primary, middle, secondary, private, special, nursery) with miles, walk and drive minutes. England: every open school from the DfE register with the latest Ofsted grade or report card, type, ages, pupils, gender, faith and selective flag. US: every public school from NCES 2024-25 (grades, pupils, pupils per teacher, charter, free lunch share, district) and private schools, plus the school district the address is in from Census boundaries, with in_your_school_district on each public school. Wales, Scotland and NI: OpenStreetMap schools. Explains how catchments and admissions work for the address. There is no national catchment map in the UK or US: the answer says who decides.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

drive_minutes.description: Add drive minutes (one router call). Default true.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

max_miles.description: Furthest school to list. Default 10, max 25.

per_level.description: Schools per level. Default 3 to 5, max 10.

name: schools_nearby
title: Schools near an address
